## Scope and authority

- [ ] The change names its owning implementation stage and authoritative sources.
- [ ] Product/provider/deployment behavior outside that stage is absent.
- [ ] Generated files and dependency changes identify their source and exact pin.

## Contract impact

- [ ] Package boundaries and public exports were checked.
- [ ] Configuration, secret/public classification, migrations, and compatibility are described.
- [ ] Privacy, security, accessibility, responsive behavior, reliability, and cost claims have evidence.

## Verification and recovery

- [ ] Exact commands/check URLs and any failure/retry are recorded.
- [ ] Synthetic evidence contains no raw environment, private data, provider payload, or secret.
- [ ] Rollback, forward compatibility, and owner-controlled gates are named.
- [ ] The PR remains draft until independent acceptance; it does not perform deployment or merge.
